title: 第四百零三章 压制第四百零二章 形态
slug: 开局a级禁物玩家给我打工
content_zh:
第四百零三章压制
菲尔德在地面上踏出了一道深坑。
书房的地板被他蹬出一个直径半米的凹陷，碎裂的木片和石砖碎片被冲击波裹挟着向四周炸开。
他的身体以肉眼几乎无法追踪的速度射向半空中的基拉，军刀在身前划出一道银色的弧线。
基拉的镰刀同时落下。
苍白镰刃和制式军刀在半空中撞击，撞击的中心炸开了一圈肉眼可见的冲击波。
冲击波击碎了书房的窗户，碎玻璃被气压推向外面的夜空，在月光下像一群逆飞的流星。
菲尔德和基拉在撞击的中心僵持了整整三秒。
一个是全身覆盖骨白鳞甲的苍白死神，一个是将肉体锤炼到极限的不败传说。
两个人的力量在军刀和镰刀的接触点上互相撕咬，谁也不退让。
军刀的刀刃在镰刃上压出了一道细密的裂纹，苍白硬壳的碎片从镰刃上剥落，露出下面暗红色的刃面。
而菲尔德握着军刀的手臂上，肌肉表面的皮肤开始出现细密的裂口，他的身体在承受超过极限的力量之后开始从内部崩裂。
下一秒菲尔德用一个不可思议的动作打破了僵局。
他没有试图硬碰硬地推赢基拉，而是在僵持中将身体向左猛然侧倾，让镰刃顺着军刀的刀锋滑下来，同时他的身体从基拉的右侧钻过去，军刀顺势横斩基拉的肋下。
这一刀连削带打，将力道的方向从正面对抗变成了侧翼突破，是肉体增幅序列最擅长的战斗方式。
用超强的身体控制力在毫厘之间找到角度和时机。
军刀砍在基拉右肋的鳞甲上，发出斩入骨头的闷响。
鳞甲在军刀的刀锋下裂开了一道口子，灰白色的碎屑溅射出来。
刀尖刺穿了鳞甲下面的软组织，触到了某种坚硬的东西，可能是肋骨。
基拉从喉咙里发出一声低沉的闷哼，骨翼猛扇，身体向后掠出数米拉开距离。

他低头看着自己右肋上那道还在冒烟的刀口。
鳞甲裂开的地方，灰白色的组织液正在缓慢地往外渗。
伤口不深，军刀被鳞甲挡住没能完全刺穿。
“龟壳挺硬。”菲尔德落在翻倒的书架上，军刀扛在肩上。
基拉看着菲尔德，右眼中的苍白光芒变得比之前更加明亮。
他的骨翼在身后完全展开，翼膜上的苍白雾气加速流动，有灰白色的微粒从翼尖脱落，飘散在空气中。
然后他举起了镰刀。
科尔温城的夜空下，塔楼上的青铜大钟在没有人敲击的情况下自己响了。
钟声比之前任何一次都更加沉重、更加缓慢、更加接近心跳的频率。
钟声从城堡最高处的破窗传出去，传遍了整座城市，传到了圣堂地下，传到了那些还在街道上站着的人墙之中。
居民们同时抬起头，用专注而清醒的目光望向城堡的方向，然后同时低声念起了那句祷告词。
“死亡是归途。”
伴随着死亡能量的补充，基拉鳞甲边缘的裂纹正在以肉眼可见的速度愈合，一层薄如蛛丝的白雾从鳞甲缝隙中渗出，覆盖在伤口表面，然后凝固成新的鳞甲。
菲尔德注意到一个细节。
基拉右肋那片新生的鳞甲颜色比周围的鳞甲更浅更脆，表面还没有形成完整的同心圆纹理。
死亡能量虽然能修复损伤，但修复后的部分不如原本的强度高。

Chapter 403: Suppression
Field dug a deep hole in the ground.
He kicked out a depression half a meter in diameter on the floor of the study room, and the broken pieces of wood and stone bricks were carried by the shock wave and exploded in all directions.
His body shot towards Kira in mid-air at a speed that was almost impossible to track with the naked eye, and the saber drew a silver arc in front of him.
Kira's scythe fell at the same time.
The pale sickle blade and the standard saber collided in mid-air, and a shock wave visible to the naked eye exploded in the center of the collision.
The shock wave shattered the study window, and the broken glass was pushed out into the night sky by the air pressure, looking like a group of retrograde meteors in the moonlight.
Field and Kira stood in a stalemate at the center of the impact for a full three seconds.
One is a pale god of death covered in bone-white scales, and the other is an undefeated legend who has tempered his body to the limit.
The strength of the two men bit each other at the point of contact between the saber and the sickle, neither of them giving in.
The blade of the saber created a fine crack on the sickle blade, and fragments of the pale hard shell peeled off from the sickle blade, revealing the dark red blade surface underneath.
On Field's arm holding the saber, fine cracks began to appear in the skin on the muscle surface, and his body began to collapse from the inside after withstanding the force that exceeded the limit.
The next second Field broke the deadlock with an incredible move.
He did not try to push Kira head-on, but in the stalemate, he leaned his body sharply to the left, letting the sickle slide down the blade of the saber. At the same time, his body passed through Kira's right side, and the saber slashed Kira's ribs.
This knife slashes and strikes, changing the direction of the force from frontal confrontation to flank breakthrough. It is the best fighting method of the physical amplification sequence.
Use your super body control to find angles and timing within millimeters.
The saber struck the scales on Kira's right rib, making a dull sound as it cut into the bone.
The scales cracked under the blade of the saber, and gray-white debris sputtered out.
The tip of the knife pierced the soft tissue under the scales and touched something hard, possibly a rib.
Kira let out a low groan from his throat, flapped his bone wings fiercely, and swept his body back a few meters away.
He looked down at the still smoking knife edge on his right rib.
Where the scales were cracked, gray-white tissue fluid was slowly seeping out.
The wound was not deep, and the saber was blocked by the scales and could not completely penetrate.
"The turtle shell is very hard." Field landed on the overturned bookshelf, holding the saber on his shoulder.
Kira looked at Field, the pale light in her right eye becoming brighter than before.
His bone wings were fully unfolded behind him, and the pale mist on the wing membrane accelerated, and gray-white particles fell off from the wing tips and scattered in the air.
Then he raised his scythe.
Under the night sky in Corwin City, the bronze bell on the tower rang without anyone ringing it.
The bell sounded heavier, slower, and closer to the frequency of a heartbeat than ever before.
The sound of the bells spread from the broken window at the highest point of the castle, throughout the city, to the basement of the church, and to the walls of people still standing in the streets.
The residents raised their heads at the same time, looked in the direction of the castle with focused and sober eyes, and then whispered the prayer at the same time.
"Death is the way home."
With the replenishment of death energy, the cracks on the edge of Kira's scales are healing at a speed visible to the naked eye. A layer of white mist as thin as spider silk seeps out from the gaps in the scales, covers the surface of the wound, and then solidifies into new scales.
Field noticed a detail.
The new scales on Kira's right rib are lighter and more brittle than the surrounding scales, and a complete concentric circle texture has not yet been formed on the surface.
Although death energy can repair damage, the repaired part is not as strong as the original.
